items.text: Manyplugscontain afuse.Thefuseisusuallyin theformofa cylinder or cartridge,which containsa thin piece ofwiremade from a metal that hasa low meltingpoint.If there is toolargea current in the circuit the fusewirebecomes veryhotandmelts.Thefuseblows'The circuit is now incomplete so there isno current.Thispreventsyou getting a shock andreduces the possibility of an electrical fire.Once the fault causing theincrease in current hasbeen corrected,theblown fuse must bereplaced with a new one of the same size before the appliance canbeused again.
